decisions.reason: Its move from a mention to a dedicated page in 2024 signals increased public commitment and sunk marketing investment, so management keeps it to justify and build on that commitment.
Having a dedicated page in both years signals strong, visible commitment and centrality to the established offer, making withdrawal hard to justify.

Although only mentioned rather than given its own page, it remains publicly listed and has received two years of investment, so sunk costs and consistency favor keeping it while attributing weak visibility to temporary causes.
As a 2024 launch it is recent and still mentioned; low early visibility can be attributed to temporary launch timing, so management keeps it rather than abandoning the investment.
It directly supports the announced expansion into charging and energy management, is publicly mentioned, and is too recent to judge, so sunk costs and strategic commitment favor keeping it.
